descriptions.enable: Protect saved email and password fields with a master password you choose. Account names, ranks, notes and other settings stay unencrypted.
descriptions.disable: Saved emails and passwords will be stored without encryption. You can enable protection again later.
descriptions.changePassword: Choose a new master password for your saved credentials.
descriptions.unlock: Enter your master password to access saved emails and passwords. You can use the rest of RankDB while credentials are locked.

password.recoveryWarning: Keep this password safe: it cannot be recovered or reset.
password.label: Master password

startupProblem.title: RankDB can't open your data
startupProblem.description: Your data has not been changed. Copies from before each upgrade are in the data folder's upgrade-copies folder.

unavailable.title: Update checks start with the first release
unavailable.description: This is a development build; it isn't updated automatically.

redesign.title: A new RankDB
redesign.description: Rebuilt from the ground up, with a glass look and a much faster list.

migration.title: Your data stays yours
migration.description: Existing Windows-protected credentials are decrypted once, then work independently of Windows keys.

credentials.title: Safer credentials
credentials.description: Choose optional master-password protection for emails and passwords in Settings. Copies stay out of clipboard history.

history.title: Rank history
history.description: Season resets keep the previous ranks for review.

reordering.title: Drag to reorder
reordering.description: Move accounts and groups by dragging, with the list making room as you go.

panel.tooltip: Glass Lab: click to expand, drag to move
panel.title: Glass Lab
panel.persistenceTooltip: Every change is saved immediately and restored on the next start

lab.strategyWarning: Baked glass can't follow an animated backdrop: it shows a frozen blur.

toastPreviews.help: Real notifications, with harmless example content. Previews stay for 15 seconds; hover pauses ordinary ones. Clear previews only removes these examples.

toastMaterial.help: Uncheck to tune glass for notifications only. The header and other overlays keep their own material.

roster.savedHelp: Edits are saved. Accounts and Reroll only shape the dummy roster below.
roster.dummyHelp: An in-memory roster for benchmarks: edits are thrown away.
roster.replaceConfirm: Click again: every saved account is replaced
roster.replace: Replace saved accounts with the dummy roster

lab.pickerPreviewHelp: Clicks in the lab do not close the picker, so changes show live.
lab.benchmarkHelp: Scrolls the list top to bottom and back at a constant speed and records every frame. Leave the mouse still while it runs.
lab.benchmarkResultsHelp: Frame times in ms. Long = frames over 1.5× the display interval. Hover a row for details.

off.label: Off
off.description: Today's RankDB: opaque boxes, no glass. The baseline every other mode is compared to.

native.label: Native
native.description: Every surface owns its backdrop filters (TaskMap MaterialSurface). Most faithful, most layers.

shared.label: Shared
shared.description: Header is native; all list surfaces share one masked filter plane (TaskMap's shared Small batch).

shell.label: Shell
shell.description: Header is native; rows are shells: tint, rim and shadow with no blur at all.

baked.label: Baked
baked.description: Zero backdrop-filter. The backdrop is blurred once into an image that glass surfaces reveal. Static backdrops only.

windowChrome.caption: Caption
windowChrome.captionDescription: No title bar. Window buttons float in the top margin above the header; the margin, header gaps and background drag the window.
windowChrome.railDescription: No title bar. A glass rail on the right holds the window buttons and the app actions; the first island shows the app name instead.

taskmap.label: TaskMap (current)
taskmap.description: Exact TaskMap recipe: Major 6+60px, Minor 5px pre-blur only.

frosted.label: TaskMap (frosted Minor)
frosted.description: TaskMap before 2026-10-11: Minor also had a 23.5px main blur.

readable.label: Readable rows
readable.description: Darker tinted rows so names and numbers stay legible over bright colour.

lean.label: Lean (cheap)
lean.description: Smaller radii, no pre-blur, overscan 1x. Same feel, far fewer pixels filtered.

success.title: Credentials saved
success.description: Design preview · no account data changed.

error.title: Could not save the account
error.description: A longer notification preview to check contrast and wrapping. Your saved accounts are unchanged.

countdown.title: Countdown preview
countdown.description: A 15-second design preview. Nothing was copied or reset.

burst.title: Preview notification {index} of 20
burst.description: The same three-card limit used by the app.
